title: A test of an action on dragged or picked items must use items that differ from the selection
rule: When an action works on the items a gesture carries (a drop, a context-menu target, a hovered row) and the app also has a selection, test it with an item outside the selection, so the carried set and the selection differ, and assert the exact ids the action received (a URL, a call argument), not only a pattern. Dragging a selected item carries the whole selection, so a test that does only that still passes when the action reads the selection instead. Check that the mutation 'use the selection' fails the test.
rationale: E44.2 (#470): the Studio-drop e2e test dragged a selected card and matched only `face=<id>&headline=<id>` as a pattern, so a drop that opened the selection instead of the dropped fonts would have passed.
